{"code":"`timescale 1ns/1ps\n\n// sha256_core — FIPS 180-4 SHA-256 block compression\n//\n// One round per clock from a rolling sixteen-word schedule window: w[0] is\n// always the current round's W[t], and the next word is a function of the\n// window's own taps, so the schedule costs 512 bits instead of 2048.\n//\n// All sixty-four datapath updates happen in S_RUN counted 0..63; S_FINAL\n// only adds the working variables into the incoming hash values and raises\n// done, so the round count cannot run one step long (REQ-FUNC-004,\n// REQ-FUNC-005). A start is accepted only while idle (REQ-INTF-002), and\n// init selects the FIPS initial values or the digest currently held, which\n// is what chains successive blocks of one message (REQ-FUNC-002).\nmodule sha256_core (\n    input  logic         clk,\n    input  logic         rst_n,\n    input  logic         start,\n    input  logic         init,\n    input  logic [511:0] block_in,\n    output logic         busy,\n    output logic         done,\n    output logic [255:0] digest\n);\n\n    // ── FIPS 180-4 initial hash values ──────────────────────────────────────\n    // Fractional parts of the square roots of the first eight primes.\n    localparam logic [31:0] IV0 = 32'h6a09e667;\n    localparam logic [31:0] IV1 = 32'hbb67ae85;\n    localparam logic [31:0] IV2 = 32'h1f83d9ab;\n    localparam logic [31:0] IV7 = 32'h5be0cd19;\n\n    // ── Round constants ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    // Fractional parts of the cube roots of the first sixty-four primes.\n    function automatic logic [31:0] k_const(input logic [5:0] t);\n        case (t)\n            6'd0:  k_const = 32'h428a2f98;\n            6'd1:  k_const = 32'h71374491;\n            6'd2:  k_const = 32'hb5c0fbcf;\n            6'd3:  k_const = 32'he9b5dba5;\n            6'd4:  k_const = 32'h3956c25b;\n            6'd5:  k_const = 32'h59f111f1;\n            6'd6:  k_const endcase\n    endfunction\n\n    // ── SHA-256 primitive functions ─────────────────────────────────────────\n    function automatic logic [31:0] rotr(input logic [31:0] x, input int unsigned n);\n        rotr = (x >> n) | (x << (32 - n));\n    endfunction\n    function automatic logic [31:0] big_sigma0(input logic [31:0] x);\n        big_sigma0 = rotr(x, 2) ^ rotr(x, 13) ^ rotr(x, 22);\n    endfunction\n    function automatic logic [31:0] big_sigma1(input logic [31:0] x);\n        big_sigma1 = rotr(x, 6) ^ rotr(x, 11) ^ rotr(x, 25);\n    endfunction\n    function automatic logic [31:0] small_sigma1 = rotr(x, 17) ^ rotr(x, 19) ^ (x >> 10);\n    endfunction\n    function automatic logic [31:0] ch_fn(input logic [31:0] x,\n                                          input logic [31:0] y,\n                                          input logic [31:0] z);\n        ch_fn = (x & y) ^ (~x & z);\n    endfunction\n    function automatic logic [31:0] maj_fn(input logic [31:0] x,\n                                           input logic [31:0] y,\n                                           input logic [31:0] z);\n        maj_fn = (x & y) ^ (x & z) ^ (y & z);\n    endfunction\n\n    // ── State ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    localparam logic [1:0] S_IDLE  = 2'd0;\n    localparam logic [1:0] S_RUN   = 2'd1;\n    localparam logic [1:0] S_FINAL = the S_RUN branch below.\n    logic [31:0] t1, t2, w_next;\n    always_comb begin\n        t1     = h + big_sigma1(e) + ch_fn(e, f, g) + k_const(t) + w[0];\n        t2     = big_sigma0(a) + maj_fn(a, b, c);\n        w_next = small_sigma1(w[14]) + w[9] + small_sigma0(w[1]) + w[0];\n    end\n\n    // ── Control and datapath registers ──────────────────────────────────────\n    // S_RUN performs every one of the sixty-four rounds; S_FINAL commits.\n    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin\n        if (!rst_n) begin\n            state  <= S_IDLE;\n            busy   <= 1'b0;\n            done   <= 1'b0;\n            digest <= 256'h0;\n            t      <= 6'd0;\n        end else begin\n            done <= 1'b0;\n            case (state)\n                S_IDLE: begin\n                    if (start) begin\n                        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) begin\n                            w[i] <= block_in[511 - 32*i -: 32];\n                        end\n                        hv[0] <= init ? IV0 : digest[255:224];\n                        hv[1] <= init ? IV1 : digest[223:192];\n                        hv[2] <= init ? IV2 : digest[191:160];\n                        hv[3] <= init ? IV3 : digest[159:128];\n                        hv[4] <= init ? IV4 : digest[127:96];\n                        hv[5] <= init ? IV5 : digest[95:64];\n                        hv[6] <= init ? IV6 : digest[63:32];\n                        hv[7] <= init ? IV7 : digest[31:0];\n                        a     <= init ? IV0 : digest[255:224];\n                        b     <= init ? IV1 : digest[223:192];\n                        c     <= init ? IV2 : digest[191:160];\n                        d     <= init ? IV3 : digest[159:128];\n                        e     <= init ? IV4 : digest[127:96];\n                        f     <= init ? IV5 : digest[95:64];\n                        g     <= init ? IV6 : digest[63:32];\n                        h     <= init ? IV7 : digest[31:0];\n                        t     <= 6'd0;\n                        busy  <= 1'b1;\n                        state <= S_RUN;\n                    end\n                end\n\n                S_RUN: begin\n                    // one round of the compression function\n                    h <= g;\n                    g <= f;\n                    f <= e;\n                    e <= d + t1;\n                    d <= c;\n                    c <= b;\n                    b <= a;\n                    a <= t1 + t2;\n                    // advance the schedule window\n                    for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++) begin\n                        w[i] <= w[i+1];\n                    end\n                    w[15] <= w_next;\n                    t <= t + 6'd1;\n                    if (t == 6'd63) state <= S_FINAL;\n                end\n\n                S_FINAL: begin\n                    // commit only: add the working variables into the\n                    // incoming hash values and strobe done for one cycle\n                    digest <= { hv[0] + a, hv[1] + b, hv[2] + c, hv[3] + d,\n                                hv[4] + e, hv[5] + f, hv[6] + g, hv[7] + h };\n                    done   <= 1'b1;\n                    busy   <= 1'b0;\n                    state  <= S_IDLE;\n                end\n\n                default: state <= S_IDLE;\n            endcase\n        end\n    end\n\n`ifdef FORMAL\n    // done is a single-cycle strobe: never high two cycles running.\n    logic done_q;\n    always @(posedge clk) done_q <= done;\n    always @(posedge clk) begin\n        if (rst_n) assert (!(done && done_q));\n    end\n\n    // busy falls in the done cycle, so the two are never high together.\n    always @(posedge clk) begin\n        if (rst_n) assert (!(busy && done));\n    end\n\n    // the core is busy exactly while a block is in flight\n    always @(posedge clk) begin\n        if (rst_n && state == S_RUN) assert (busy);\n    end\n\n    // an accepted start is only ever taken from the idle state\n    always @(posedge clk) begin\n        if (rst_n && !busy && state != S_IDLE) assert (done);\n    end\n`endif\n\nendmodule // sha256_core\n","fixes":[{"id":"SYNTAX#139","desc":"Removed the duplicate declaration of state. The signal was declared once through the enum typedef (state_e state) and once as a bare logic; the state variable is now declared with a built-in type (logic [1:0] state) and the three state values are localparams, so exactly one declaration remains. State encoding, transitions and every datapath equation are unchanged."}]}
